name: agent-tui
title_zh: 让 AI 替你按键盘，终端界面自动测
tagline_zh: 写测试最怕交互界面点不动？这个技能让 AI 直接驱动终端 UI，自动敲命令、看输出、验行为，回归测试不用人肉盯屏。
tagline_en: Stop babysitting interactive terminals. This skill lets AI press keys, read screens, and verify behavior—turning.
desc_en: Main Agents: Do NOT use this skill directly. If you need to test the TUI, invoke the `tui_tester` subagent. Drive terminal UI (TUI) applications programmatically for testing, automation, and inspection. Use when: automating CLI/TUI interactions, regression testing terminal apps, or verifying interactive behavior. Also use when: user asks "what is agent-tui", "what does agent-tui do", "demo agent-t
why_zh: 不是模拟点击，是真正驱动 TUI 程序，能读屏、能按键、能断言输出，把交互测试变成可重复的自动化脚本。
why_en: Not click simulation—real TUI driving with screen reading, key sending, and output assertion. Makes interactive testing.
limit_zh: 只适用于终端 UI（TUI）程序，不碰图形界面和网页。需要目标程序在本地可运行，且依赖子代理执行，不能直接调用。
limit_en: Terminal UIs only—no GUI or web. Target app must run locally. Requires subagent invocation; not directly callable.
title_en: Drive terminal UIs automatically for testing
